_comment: Business-line template: Vermicompost unit (from client business-overview doc; not a NIFTEM-format source). Product unit is MT (Rs 4,500/MT compost; per-kg prices would round to zero in the engine). Wastage 50% = organic-waste-to-compost conversion. Vermiwash + earthworm sales are folded into the effective sale price. Scheme: MIDH (vermicompost is not food processing, PM-FME does not apply).

narrative.product_intro: Vermicompost is a premium solid organic fertiliser produced by earthworms (Eisenia fetida) converting farm waste, market waste and cow dung into nutrient-rich manure; the process also yields vermiwash (liquid organic fertiliser) and surplus earthworm culture as supplementary revenue, folded here into the effective realization per tonne.
narrative.raw_material_note: Raw materials are locally sourced organic waste - farm residue, market waste and cow dung - available at nominal cost; consistent supply is best formalised through farm and municipal waste-collection tie-ups.
process_steps: Collection of organic waste (farm waste, market waste, cow dung)
Loading of cement beds under covered shed
Inoculation with earthworm mother culture (Eisenia fetida)
Moisture and temperature maintenance over the 65-70 day cycle
Packing in graded bags (5 kg / 10 kg / 25 kg)
